pairs.registryProposal: doc-rot-detection's dead-reference signal should name in-source usage headers (a script's own 'run me with' line) as part of the document population. prose-as-an-execution-surface explicitly disclaims checking that commands work, so a run line orphaned by a file rename is owned by neither technique as written.
